description: This file defines classes and functions for managing code coverage analysis using tools like gcovr, lcov, and gcov. It includes classes for coverage tools, methods for retrieving and creating coverage data, and a function to run coverage analysis based on options.

classes.name: CoverageTool
classes.description: Base class for coverage tools, providing common methods for data retrieval, file creation, and report generation.

classes.name: Lcov
classes.description: Subclass of CoverageTool for handling lcov-specific coverage data collection and report generation.

classes.name: Gcovr
classes.description: Subclass of CoverageTool for handling gcovr-specific coverage data collection and report generation.

methods.name: CoverageTool.factory
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a coverage tool object based on the specified tool name.

methods.name: CoverageTool.retrieve_gcov_data
methods.description: Static method to parse coverage dump data from a file.

methods.name: CoverageTool.create_gcda_files
methods.description: Static method to generate gcda files from extracted coverage data.

methods.name: CoverageTool.generate
methods.description: Method to process coverage data and generate reports.

methods.name: Lcov.get_version
methods.description: Retrieve the version of the lcov tool.

methods.name: Lcov.add_ignore_file
methods.description: Add a filename pattern to ignore during coverage.

methods.name: Lcov.add_ignore_directory
methods.description: Add a directory pattern to ignore during coverage.

methods.name: Lcov.run_command
methods.description: Execute a command for lcov operations.

methods.name: Lcov.run_lcov
methods.description: Run lcov commands with specific arguments.

methods.name: Gcovr.get_version
methods.description: Retrieve the version of the gcovr tool.

methods.name: Gcovr.add_ignore_file
methods.description: Add a filename pattern to ignore during coverage.

methods.name: Gcovr.add_ignore_directory
methods.description: Add a directory pattern to ignore during coverage.

methods.name: Gcovr._interleave_list
methods.description: Helper to interleave a prefix with list items.

methods.name: run_coverage
methods.description: Main function to run coverage analysis based on test plan and options.
